questions.question: Which construction workflows cause the most manual work, delay or money loss?
Who pays for software today, and how much?
How big is public-works demand reachable through GeM/CPPP?
What do current site and ERP apps cover, and what do users complain about?
Which regulations create recurring paperwork (RERA, BOCW, GST)?
Why now: new rails, mandates or adoption shifts?
Where does language friction slow work?
Which competitors exist, what do they charge, and where is the white space?
Which newcomers are succeeding, and why?
